name: Orendil Broadleaf
summary: At Maestra's Post in western Ashenvale, Orendil Broadleaf tends to the sick. His knowledge of forest plants helps him make remedies for young lives in the troubled woodlands.

sections.title: Healer of the Forest Border
sections.body: At Maestra's Post on Ashenvale's western border, Orendil Broadleaf tends to the sick. He knows the local herbs and how to use them in healing remedies. Travelers passing through gather rare plants and other natural ingredients for him. As tension and conflict press closer to the forest, Orendil keeps his attention on protecting his kin and easing their ailments.

sections.title: A Race Against Sickness
sections.body: Orendil Broadleaf works to cure Relara Whitemoon, an afflicted child in Astranaar. He studies Ashenvale's plants, including Bathran's hair, and devises potent elixirs to hold back the deadly sickness. Relara remains in danger, and Orendil's remedies are meant to keep the illness at bay.

faq.answer: Orendil Broadleaf is a night elf herbalist and healer at Maestra's Post in western Ashenvale. He is skilled with herbs and healing.

faq.q: Where can Orendil Broadleaf be found?
faq.answer: Orendil Broadleaf can be found at Maestra's Post, a night elf outpost along the main path in western Ashenvale, near the border with Darkshore.

faq.q: What is Orendil trying to cure?
faq.answer: Orendil formulates a curative draught to save Relara Whitemoon, an ailing night elf child in Astranaar. He uses rare herbs gathered from Ashenvale's wild reaches.

angles.text: Orendil relies on regional plants to save lives, including rare botanicals such as Bathran's hair, which he uses to brew potent antidotes in the field.
As a night elf defending Ashenvale, you can look to Orendil for remedies that may save even a deathly ill child.
